shortDescription: Bangkok Bank SET:BBL has started marketing five- and 10-year senior unsecured U.S dollar bonds, according to a term sheet seen on Wednesday.

children: has started marketing five- and 10-year senior unsecured U.S dollar bonds, according to a term sheet seen on Wednesday.
The bank gave initial price guidance at about 105 basis points over U.S. Treasury yields for the five-year bonds and 130 basis points over Treasury yields for the 10-year bonds.
The bank is marketing benchmark-sized bonds. The final size has not been set.
The bonds will mature in September 2031 and September 2036. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes.
